mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, which may stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases but SPX 20-day returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates reduced demand in the housing market, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines but SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced supply-side activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic output slows.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines but SPX 20-day returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in both unemployment (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market contradictions, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic uncertainty increases.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and PAYEMS rise but SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a monetary tightening cycle may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as borrowing costs increase and consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is high but SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals weakening demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows but SPX 60-day returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real disposable income (RSAFS) indicates reduced consumer spending power, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as demand for goods and services slows.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines but SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time.
